thread:
Leah: Quick debrief from today's Waveloop onboarding call — they were enthusiastic but surfaced 6 concrete asks and one renewal risk. Captured notes below, pls react with priority 👍/👀.

Omar: Thanks — big flag: their finance team saw unexpected per-route charges last week and that bumped the CFO. Renewal in ~6 weeks, so this is time-sensitive. :eyes:

Riley: Can you paste the specific billing example? we need repro to decide whether it's a UI/UX clarity issue vs backend metering.

Leah: Quote from their ops lead: "We thought embeddings calls were part of the base plan; the per-route line item doubled our POC spend overnight." They attached a screenshot but it's a CSV of usage. I'll add to the ticket.

Kai: If it's metering, possible quick mitigation is to add the per-route toggle behind a feature flag and default to off for trial orgs. Low-effort: patch gateway to report per-route usage to analytics with the customer_id tag.

Priya: From AE side — we need a one-pager explaining billing lines and a customer-facing remediation (credit + doc). If we can't commit a fix, credits will be required to keep the renewal on track.

Leah: Agreed. Other asks (from highest->lowest customer priority):
```
1) Per-route billing toggle + clearer invoice labels
2) SSO / SCIM onboarding automation (reduce manual steps)
3) Embedding prefetch / caching to lower token cost for search use-case
4) Per-route traffic throttling control in Console
5) Out-of-the-box prompt templates for chat assistants
6) Usage export with per-request metadata (for finance/PS)
```

Devin: For prioritization: 1, 3, and 6 are tightly linked to their cost risk. Recommend we triage 1 and 6 as P0 for CS/Finance runway. 3 is P1 (requires infra work).

Riley: I'll slot a quick triage this afternoon. @Kai can you estimate effort for 1 (UI label + toggle) and 6 (export schema + API)?

Kai: Rough guesses: UI label + toggle = 2-3 dev days + QA; Export schema + API = 4-6 dev days + docs. Prefetch/caching is larger (architectural) — need deeper scoping.

Omar: Action items from CS: Leah will send the screenshot and invoice example to product and finance. I'll draft the customer-facing note offering a one-time credit if we can't ship a fix in 2 weeks.

CSBot: Automated note: created ticket CS-1279 "Waveloop billing clarity + export" and linked to internal epic RED-834.

Leah: Leaving the triage checklist here:
- [ ] Attach invoice screenshot (done: added in thread)
- [ ] Create a short FAQ blurb for customers on billing lines (Priya)
- [ ] Product triage meeting (Riley + Kai)
- [ ] Engineer estimate (Kai)
- [ ] Customer remediation email & credit plan (Omar)

Priya: I'll draft the one-pager and the email template by EOD. Put me down for follow-up on Monday with the renewal owner.

Riley: Meeting set at 1600 today — I'll send calendar invite and add triage notes to RED-834.

Leah: Thanks team. If anyone sees blockers on the triage, ping me. My plan: synthesize the asks into the feature intake (include customer quotes), mark billing clarity as high-risk for renewal.

Kai: FYI — quick workaround we can deploy immediately: hide per-route invoice line for trial orgs in the billing UI (frontend toggle + backend flag). I'll follow up with a PR link once I start. :+1:

Omar: Great — that should buy us breathing room. I'll call the customer today to acknowledge and give interim remediation.

Devin: Noted. I'll update account health tracker to "at-risk -> mitigated (pending)" after email goes out.

Leah: Perfect. Closing the loop: I'll post the follow-up call note here after the customer conversation. Thanks all. :card_index_dividers:
